sources.title: Mostafa-Rezaali/HeatCast-Global - GitHub
sources.snippet: The reference architecture remains the HeatCast-W34 Distributional Mesh GNN: direct single-pass inference with a Gaussian mean/sigma head, Gaussian CRPS training, tube attention, and five year-disjoint folds. The CFM sampling path remains available for full-field ensemble and tail analyses.
